info.title: OxiBelt Admin API
info.description: Authenticated OxiBelt Admin API contract for control-plane automation. IPM authorization uses resource-specific Admin scopes such as cache policy/host, dynamic-policy source/name/route, upstream-pool server, stream-pool server, and typed IPM resources.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: Unified Admin request audit records from the configured durable audit store.

tags.name: operations
tags.description: Long-running Admin operation journal, polling, cancellation, terminal receipts, and event streams. Durable PostgreSQL-backed and explicitly ephemeral operation classes are distinguished on every snapshot.

tags.name: config
tags.description: Runtime configuration validation, diff, load, rollback, and TLS reload.

tags.name: files
tags.description: Explicit config and OxiRule file synchronization.

tags.name: cache
tags.description: Cache diagnostics, warming, and purging. Mutations check policy/<policy> and host/<normalized-host> resources.

tags.name: waf
tags.description: WAF telemetry, rulepack summaries, and OxiRule development tools.

tags.name: ipm
tags.description: Identity Permission Management reads, mutations, and authorization simulation with typed resources such as principal/<id>, credential/<id>, policy/<name>, binding/<id>, audit/current, and simulation/current.

tags.name: dynamic-policy
tags.description: Dynamic policy automation scoped by source/<source>/name/<name> and optional route/<route> resources.

tags.name: upstream-pools
tags.description: Runtime upstream-pool inspection and server control. Server snapshots include health reason, health-check time, outlier ejection, slow-start, and effective-weight fields. Server mutations check <pool>/server/<server_id> resources.

tags.name: stream-pools
tags.description: Runtime TCP/UDP stream-pool inspection and server control. Server mutations check <pool>/server/<server_id> stream-pool resources and require tcp:// or udp:// origins.

bearerAuth.description: Admin bearer token supplied by IPM credentials or bootstrap Admin token. When Admin mTLS workload binding is enabled, it must resolve to the same principal as the verified client certificate.

mutualTLS.description: Optional Admin workload identity. Runtime configuration may require a verified client certificate and bind its exact SPIFFE, URI SAN, or DNS SAN to an IPM principal; inspect /admin/v1/capabilities for the active mode.

MutationRequestId.description: Caller-supplied canonical UUID identifying the protected mutation.

MutationRevision.description: Logical revision committed or referenced by the protected mutation.

IdempotentReplay.description: True only when the response is the retained result of an exact request replay.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Active config, IPM, dynamic-policy, or upstream-pool ETag from the corresponding status endpoint.

IfMatchOptional.name: If-Match
IfMatchOptional.description: Optional ETag from the corresponding status endpoint. When supplied, it is enforced as a precondition.

MutationEnvelope.name: X-OxiBelt-Mutation
MutationEnvelope.description: Mode-dependent unpadded base64url strict MutationEnvelope JSON. It is required when admin.mutations.mode is required, validated when supplied in optional mode, and ignored by the replay guard when protection is off. The signature binds the authenticated principal, IPM namespace, HTTP method, exact path/query, normalized strong If-Match operational ETag, unsigned envelope fields, and SHA-256 digest of the exact transmitted body. expected_previous_revision remains the distinct durable logical revision precondition.

PersonProofRevocationIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
PersonProofRevocationIdempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key for Person proof clearance revocation. The same key and normalized request replay the original result while its tombstone remains active; reusing it with a different request returns 409.

AdminOperationIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
AdminOperationIdempotencyKey.description: Optional durable operation retry key. Exact authenticated request replays return the same operation and stable terminal receipt; reuse for different request content returns 409. The raw value is never persisted.

AdminOperationAsyncPreference.name: Prefer
AdminOperationAsyncPreference.description: Requests asynchronous execution. Supported source endpoints return 202 and an operation snapshot when selected.

AdminListLimit.name: limit
AdminListLimit.description: Enables opt-in pagination and limits the number of returned list items.

AdminListCursor.name: cursor
AdminListCursor.description: Opaque cursor returned in pagination.next_cursor. The cursor is bound to the endpoint, sort, order, and filters.

AdminOperationId.name: id
AdminOperationId.description: Canonical operation ID with op_ prefix and UUIDv4 payload.

action.description: Dynamic policy action. silent_close closes or resets the downstream connection without sending an HTTP response and does not support status, body, rate, or burst.

subject_type.description: Dynamic policy subject type. Hash subjects use canonical prefixes fingerprint:, binding:, clearance:, or hash: with a SHA-256 value; route variants store '<subject>|<route_name>'.

origin.description: Stream upstream origin. Must use tcp://host:port or udp://host:port.

ConfigValidationReport.description: Stable machine-readable validation report for an include-free Admin TOML candidate. Production file/include validation remains a local tooling operation.

ConfigExplainReport.description: Secret-safe explanation of one field from the active redacted configuration snapshot.

MutationResult.description: Protected mutation terminal result. An exact replay returns a reduced retained bounded safe result with the original status, not necessarily the first response body, without reapplying the mutation.

SecretReferenceActivationResult.description: First application or reduced exact-replay result for a successful atomic secret-reference activation. Secret values and provider paths are never returned.

MutationReceipt.description: Bounded redacted protected-mutation receipt containing the durable logical revision chain and reduced safe replay result.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid bearer/workload credential, or invalid mutation signer binding/signature.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated actor is not authorized by IPM.

Conflict.description: Request conflicts with the active store mode, static IPM bootstrap entries, protected mutation request ID/revision, or unresolved prior mutation.

ImmutableRolloutConflict.description: The Pod is assigned to a Kubernetes immutable configuration rollout, so local configuration mutation is disabled.

SecretReferenceActivationConflict.description: Activation conflicts with Kubernetes immutable rollout authority, the selected target or material, candidate runtime preflight, validation evidence, active snapshot state, or protected-mutation claim state.

PreconditionRequired.description: A mutating request omitted the required If-Match ETag or X-OxiBelt-Mutation envelope.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method is not allowed for this Admin endpoint.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Admin control plane, mutation replay ledger, enforcing audit, or current fixed-member rollout authority is unavailable. Protected cluster writes fail closed when exact membership or fencing evidence cannot be proved.

InternalError.description: Internal Admin response encoding or control-plane error.

phase.description: Current durable rollout phase; equal to state for this receipt version.

result.description: Reduced bounded safe result retained for replay. It may include token_recoverable=false and is not necessarily the first response body.

reference.description: Contained configured downstream TLS key path; raw key bytes are forbidden.

field.description: Allowlisted typed configuration reference; arbitrary TOML paths are forbidden.

reference.description: Environment-variable name or contained file path; raw secret values are forbidden.

file.description: Logical path relative to the configuration entry directory; absolute host paths are not returned.
Logical path relative to the configuration entry directory; absolute host paths are not returned.

digests_withheld.description: True when stable policy and manifest digests are withheld because they encode redacted filesystem paths.

effective_value.description: Omitted whenever the field is classified as secret-bearing or its effective value was redacted.

OperationalProfileStatus.description: Built-in operational profile selected by the active configuration. This field is omitted when no profile is selected.

ConfigRolloutStatus.description: Process rollout identity for mutable, Kubernetes immutable, or PostgreSQL-backed fixed-member Admin rollout mode. Cluster convergence is proved by guarded mutation commit rather than this local status object. This object is additive to the existing config status response.

instance_id.description: Kubernetes Pod UID in immutable mode; null for mutable deployments.

desired_revision.description: Assigned immutable ConfigMap name, if any.

applied_revision.description: Assigned revision after full configuration validation and snapshot construction.

digest.description: Raw SHA-256 of the exact mounted generated TOML bytes, if assigned.

exceptions.description: Number of rulepack exception entries declared by the loaded manifest.

source_url.description: Sanitized source URL recorded when oxibeltctl installed the rulepack from a URL.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact downloaded rulepack bytes.

source_openpgp_signature_url.description: Sanitized detached OpenPGP signature URL when the signature was downloaded separately.

source_openpgp_signer_fingerprint.description: Full OpenPGP signer fingerprint that verified the downloaded rulepack.

manifest.description: Inline schema-version-2 OxiRule rulepack manifest. Schema version 1 and legacy variables.discovery manifests are rejected.

values.description: Scalar render values keyed by rulepack variable name.

bindings.description: Resolved binding values keyed by rulepack binding name.

rule_overrides.description: Values-file rule overrides using the rulepack schema-v2 override shape.

exceptions.description: Values-file rulepack exceptions using the schema-v2 exception shape.

rendered_manifest.description: Concrete rendered schema-v2 rulepack manifest. Omitted until required inputs are complete.

permission_hints.description: Actions needed for optional report sections.

upstream.description: Configured upstream or upstream-pool name only; URLs, credentials, TLS details, token environment variables, and file paths are not returned.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Shared-state cursors are versioned and namespace-bound; discard them after a backend or deployment change.

atomic_secret_reference_activation.description: True for mutable and fixed-member admin_cluster runtimes; false when per-Pod mutation is blocked, including kubernetes_immutable rollout mode.

package_version.description: Effective OxiBelt build version, distinct from the Cargo workspace sentinel.

source_revision.description: Exact Git commit embedded by Git-aware builds, or unknown for a source archive.

source_ref.description: Validated full Git branch or tag ref, or unknown when no source ref is available.

source_dirty.description: Whether tracked index or worktree content differed from the source revision at build time.

build_kind.description: Build identity derivation and trust class. Official is a build assertion whose trust comes from release provenance.

person_proof_asset_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact built-in Person Proof challenge asset embedded in this binary.

admin_openapi_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact Admin OpenAPI document embedded in this binary.
